    - The cores sit on my shelf beside the ledger. I knock on them sometimes. They do not answer, which is more than my sister does.

    - My sister [Aldith](../npcs/aldith.md) still keeps our mother's cottage, and calls my tinctures mint at a Scholars' price. She is not entirely wrong.
    - The household, the Guard and anyone who knocks. A queen and a kitchen boy get the same cold hands. I was there when both the royal children were born.
    - Every wound that has come through my door for thirty years. Burns, falls, broken fingers. Now claws and bites, enough for a second volume.
    - I draw each one to scale. Some match no beast in the old books: claws spaced wrongly, a bite that closed from too many sides. I should like very much to know what made them.
